svg.aria-label: Caper architecture: web, iOS, Android and desktop clients reach the Rust API, Rust gateway and web server on AWS through Cloudflare Tunnel; voice audio flows through Cloudflare's Realtime SFU, files through R2 and the CDN Worker, link previews through the Embed Worker; data lives in PlanetScale Postgres with Valkey for fanout; the API uses Amazon SES, APNs/FCM and OpenRouter, and clients search GIFs on KLIPY.
svg.text: Control traffic runs on AWS. Voice audio, files and link previews stay on Cloudflare.
